image_description: A side-profile view of an American Bison standing in a grassy field. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a large head featuring a visible curved horn and a beard. The hindquarters are less furred and lighter brown. Only the front legs are clearly visible; the rear legs are obscured by the angle and vegetation. The background consists of green grass and blurred shrubs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is large and broad relative to the body. One horn is clearly visible, appearing short and curved. The other is occluded by the head angle but consistent with the visible one.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, shaggy beard of dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the taxonomy description.
The eye is visible as a small dark spot amidst the facial fur, consistent with the description.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the ear region is covered by the thick mane/fur, which is characteristic of bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive build with a high shoulder hump, creating the characteristic sloping back profile of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, dark, shaggy fur that forms a clear, prominent hump at the shoulders.
There is a visible transition from the dark, shaggy forequarter fur to shorter, lighter brown fur on the rear flank and hindquarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is relatively short and stout compared to the massive size of the head and body.
The feet/hooves are completely obscured by the tall grass and the angle of the image. While the upper legs look sturdy, the specific diagnostic feature (cloven hooves) cannot be verified.
The tail is not visible in this side-profile crop; it is either occluded by the hind leg or outside the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Transition zone between neck mane and shoulder hump
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight smudging or 'painterly' blending in the fur texture where the dark mane meets the brown shoulder fur. It lacks the crisp individual strand definition seen in high-resolution photography, suggesting minor AI generation softness.

The anatomy of the front left leg's knee/carpal joint appears slightly indistinct and 'mushy'. The transition from the upper leg to the lower leg lacks a sharp anatomical definition, looking somewhat fused rather than jointed.
The background shrubs have a slightly inconsistent depth-of-field blur, with some elements appearing unnaturally flat or smeared, typical of AI-generated backgrounds.
